item.title: No Expiration Date
item.description: Is there a deadline on God’s power? Has your situation gone “too far”? In this powerful message, “No Expiration Date” from Book of Jeremiah 32:27, we are reminded of God’s unchanging declaration: “Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there anything too hard for me?” When hope feels outdated and the promise seems past due, God’s power is still fresh, active, and unstoppable. This sermon will encourage you to trust that no circumstance, no diagnosis, no delay, and no mistake can outlast
